title: incident-bot: on-call diagnostics telemetry + structured runbook linking
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add structured telemetry for on-call diagnostics and automatic linking to canonical runbooks. This change instruments the incident-bot diagnostics flow to emit granular telemetry for steps taken during an on-call run (collecting SLO context, fetching recent alerts, health checks, KV cache dumps) and surfaces canonical runbook links in a structured payload so downstream UIs and chatops clients can render quick-action links. Motivation: give on-call teams better observability into automated diagnostics, make runbook linking reliable across private deployments, and enable downstream cost/latency analysis for auto-diagnostics. Changes include: 1) new telemetry events and tags (diagnostic.start, diagnostic.step, diagnostic.complete, diagnostic.error) with duration and outcome; 2) runbook registry lookup with fallbacks and canonical URL normalization; 3) enrichment of oncall summary messages with structured runbook_link objects; 4) feature flag gate (feature.oncall_diagnostics_telemetry) and rollout plan; 5) unit and integration tests plus updated docs. Testing: unit tests added, end-to-end sandbox integration validated against staging runbook registry, manual on-call rehearsal performed. Rollout: disabled by default, gradual opt-in via feature flag, monitor telemetry for error spikes and extra latency. Checklist: [x] telemetry schema and docs updated, [x] integration tests, [x] feature flag added, [x] reviewers acked, [x] migration-safe. Linear tasks referenced: ENG-4821 tracked rollout and dashboarding.
